The background remains the same studio-like living room. (3) She presents small, white, bear-shaped sticky notes to the camera while colorful pen cases are lined up on the sofa behind her. (4) A close-up shot shows hands writing and drawing zig-zag lines with a purple glitter marker in a notebook on the table. (5) The woman reappears, gesturing broadly with an overwhelmed, joyful expression, followed by a montage of her writing and a final screen featuring static and text overlays.
